comment: end.c really_done() calls exit_nhwindows() before topten(); tty_suspend_nhwindows() -> settty() -> term_end_screen() clears the screen even when an earlier configuration-error report has already put the recorder in raw mode, and its raw_print("") then advances the raw row.  A repeated boolean option produces the report; the Caveman quits and answers q to the first disclosure question, so done_stopprint leaves the final screen blank.
